seo.title: Interview with a victim of domestic abuse – B1+ English Listening Test - Test-English
seo.description: English upper-intermediate listening test. Domestic violence. Transcription included. Watch an interview and answer the questions.

parts:
B1+ English Listening Test

Watch an interview with a victim of domestic abuse. For questions 1 to 9, decide if the statements are true or false. You can see the transcription after submitting your answers.

See the full list of B1+ listening tests
Questions

questions.prompt: She is still not divorced from the man who abused her.
The abuse started a few days after the wedding.
Before the first aggression, their relationship had been excellent.
The second and third beatings took place during their honeymoon.
She never thought she was a victim of domestic abuse during her relationship.
She thought her husband was a victim who needed her help.
She left her husband after he assured her that he was going to kill her.
He made her move to New York city.
Abusers usually feel pity for their partners, they feel sorry for them.
